Summary: Confirms the emergency release window remains bounded, reversible, and adequately staffed before approval is granted.
EntryCriteria: Blast radius and emergency validation evidence are available.
ExitCriteria: The emergency window has explicit start conditions, rollback triggers, watch owners, and communication coverage.
Checks: Blast radius is explicit and bounded.
Emergency validation evidence names what was and was not tested.
Rollback trigger and stop conditions are explicit.
Watch owner and communication owner are named.
